note: All people, numbers, addresses and dates here are fictional. Two answers are deliberately absent (postcode, member_number) and one is deliberately contradictory (preferred_start): the tool must ask, never guess. The favourite-vegetable fact has no field on the form and must not appear anywhere on the page. The signature is never filled by the tool; the tester adds it.
factsText:
My name is Avery Quill and I was born on 4 March 1991.
You can reach me on 555-0142 or at avery.quill@example.org.
I live at 14 Hollow Lane, Marlowe Vale.
I would like the medium plot, and I would like to start on 1 March 2027. Actually, make that from mid-April instead.
I do not need a raised bed, but I am happy to join the summer watering rota.
My favourite vegetable is the purple carrot.
Please sign it as of 2 October 2026.

member_number.why: No member number appears in the facts. The tool must ask, not invent digits.

date_of_birth.why: 4 March 1991 written as DD/MM/YYYY, as the label asks.

street_address.why: Street and house number; the town belongs in the town field.

postcode.why: No postcode appears in the facts. The tool must ask, not invent one.

plot_medium.why: The facts ask for the medium plot. Exactly one plot box is checked.

preferred_start.why: The facts say both '1 March 2027' and, later, 'actually from mid-April'. This must stay a question with both options shown.

needs_raised_bed.why: The facts say a raised bed is not needed.

joins_watering_rota.why: The facts say the person is happy to join the watering rota.

signature.why: Never filled by the tool. The person signs explicitly.

signed_date.why: 'Sign it as of 2 October 2026' written as DD/MM/YYYY.

office_received.why: Office-use field. It must stay empty.
